exceptions.reason: Runtime major and build both trail the catalog pin.
exceptions.risk: The application asserts this runtime major in three places and cannot move alone.
controls: One bounded exception covers the transition and the as-built build.

exceptions.reason: The package manager ships with the runtime major.
exceptions.risk: The build is ahead of the catalog pin inside the same major.
controls: The package manager follows the runtime transition and expires with it.

exceptions.reason: The engine is embedded in a pinned native dependency.
exceptions.risk: A patch older than the catalog pin is linked into the application.
controls: The native dependency is pinned by lock file and upgraded with it.

exceptions.reason: The application runs an earlier minor of the framework.
exceptions.risk: Fixes released after the declared build are absent.
controls: The framework upgrade is tracked by the migration Issue and expires with the exception.

exceptions.reason: The frontend build trails the catalog pin.
exceptions.risk: Fixes released after the declared build are absent.
controls: The frontend upgrade follows the framework upgrade.

exceptions.reason: The ORM build trails the catalog pin.
exceptions.risk: Fixes released after the declared build are absent.
controls: The ORM upgrade requires a schema regression run and is tracked separately.

exceptions.reason: The toolchain major trails the preferred major.
exceptions.risk: The next toolchain major is a separate compatibility Change.
controls: One bounded exception covers the transition and the as-built build.

exceptions.reason: The base image follows the runtime major this application still runs.
exceptions.risk: The image is a sunset runtime major and its base OS ages with it.
controls: The image is pinned by catalog digest, never by a mutable tag.
